parent_objective: design active-set mining that uses history sensitivity as the acceptance criterion
blocked_by: M1573 history-positive evidence is source-narrow despite live intervention harness

public_gates: M1575 must design a bounded no-training history-sensitive active-set miner
M1575 must use wrong-history/donor-plus-hidden outcome degradation as a primary acceptance criterion
M1575 must include current-frame substitution controls
M1575 must pre-register source-family and high-speed/late-reveal reporting gates
M1575 must not run implementation smoke or history interventions
M1575 must keep materialization training PPO promotion and private holdout blocked

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a miner that directly targets history-sensitive active-set anchors after M1573 source-narrow intervention evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no simulator run, history interventions, candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, corpus export, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design treats M1573 t5_near-only positives as source-diverse proof
stop if design omits current-frame controls
stop if design routes directly to materialization, training, PPO, or private holdout
fallback_plan: route to bounded public miner implementation if design is explicit
route to branch synthesis if history-sensitive mining cannot be made source-diverse
keep M1573 as live-harness public diagnostic evidence only
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1574 admits a new history-sensitive active-set mining design after source-narrow result

admission_evidence: M1573 intervention harness is live but history positives are source-narrow
M1574 rejects materialization and routes to history-sensitive mining
allowed_updates: M1575 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up implementation manifest if design admits it

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1575 is design-only but must include controls to prevent current-frame substitution from being misread as history evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If later mining remains source-narrow, synthesize or pivot rather than lowering source-diversity or self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: no promotion, training corpus export, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: A history-sensitive active-set miner can be designed to find source-diverse anchors where policy history interventions change closed-loop outcome.
success_criteria: design uses history intervention outcome degradation as an acceptance criterion
design pre-registers source-family and high-speed/late-reveal gates
design blocks materialization training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export and self-ID claims
failure_criteria: design treats M1573 source-narrow positives as source-diverse self-ID evidence
design routes directly to training PPO promotion private holdout corpus export actor-input changes candidate materialization or implementation without gates
decision_rule: M1575 passes if it designs a bounded history-sensitive active-set miner before implementation.
